title: What is Zen, Part 3
speaker: Heigaku Talus Latona and Nyogen Connie Martin
summary: The talk highlights the significance of Sangha, or community, in Zen Buddhism, emphasizing that it encompasses not only monastic communities but also all living beings and nonliving entities. The speaker encourages listeners to cultivate admirable friends, colleagues, and virtues in their own Sangha, recognizing its essential role in spiritual growth and maturity. By doing so, individuals can develop the qualities necessary for a fulfilling and meaningful life, including discernment, persistence, and virtuous behavior.
